messages:
eli_newhire: Hey team — quick onboarding benefits/payroll questions from my first week. TL;DR: when do health/dental actually start, is PTO prorated for mid-month starts, how do I file the $150 home office desk reimbursement, and will my first paycheck be prorated?

sophie (People Ops): Congrats and welcome! :tada: Short answers first: benefits effective date is the first of the month after 30 days from your start date (unless you picked the expedited option during enroll). PTO is pro-rated based on your hire date in the pay period. Reimbursements go through Ramp (or submit via the expense form if you don't have a card). First paycheck/proration: payroll cycles apply — see below.

eli_newhire: thanks — my start date was 2026-02-18. So health waits until 2026-04-01? just making sure i schedule dentist accordingly.

sophie (People Ops): Right — 30-day waiting period means coverage effective 2026-04-01. If you need urgent care before then email benefits@redwood.com and we can check temporary options. Also: deadline to enroll in benefits is 14 days from your hire date, so you still have time to pick HMO vs PPO.

alec_finance: Reimbursements: snap a photo of receipt and submit via Ramp expense with category = "Onboarding - Home Office". If you don't have Ramp access yet, upload to our expense Google Form and cc finance@redwood.com. Example expense note we accept: 

```
Expense: Home office desk
Amount: $150.00
Date: 2026-02-20
Receipt: attached_photo.jpg
Category: Onboarding - Home Office
Project: N/A
Notes: One-time new hire desk purchase
```

alec_finance: Once submitted, finance approves within 3 business days and it hits your bank via payroll off-cycle or on next regular payroll depending on timing.

mike_payroll: For pay: Redwood runs semi-monthly payroll on the 15th and last day of month. Since you started 2/18, your first pay (2/28 run) will include prorated earnings from 2/18–2/28. Any reimbursements approved after payroll cutoff will be issued on the next run. If you want an off-cycle reimbursement faster, mark it urgent in the Ramp note and tag @alec_finance.

eli_newhire: great. PTO question — will I see a prorated balance in the benefits portal or do I need to request it from People Ops?

sophie (People Ops): You should see prorated PTO in the Rippling benefits portal within 1 pay cycle. If it doesn't appear, DM me and I’ll create a manual adjustment. Also FYI — company observed holidays are listed in the handbook page under "Holidays & Time Off" (link: https://intranet.redwood.com/handbook/time-off).

hr-bot: Automated reminder: New hire benefits enrollment — please complete your elections in the Rippling portal by 2026-03-03 to avoid default selections.

eli_newhire: one more — W-4/tax forms were already submitted during offer flow; do I need to re-upload anywhere?

mike_payroll: If you completed W-4 during offer and it shows "Submitted" in Rippling, you're good. If you need to change allowances or state withholding, update Rippling and notify payroll.

sophie (People Ops): Cool — I'll watch for your enrollment. If you want, DM me the Ramp receipt link after you submit and I'll nudge finance to expedite. :slightly_smiling_face:

eli_newhire: Thank you all! Super helpful. I'll submit Ramp expense now and finish elections tonight. Appreciate it. :pray:
